lines: Atul Hiralal Shah, Investor Selling Shareholder, may receive up to ₹1.70 crore if all offered shares are sold; timing says in hand since 11 Mar 2026.
Proceeds are calculated from the offer price; employee-portion shares sell at a discount, so actual proceeds are slightly lower.
Shares unlocked on 9 Sep 2026, 66 days ago; the up to ₹1.26 crore gain is before offer expenses and taxes.
Retained value is an estimate of ₹3.97 crore at offer price. Family link: shares surname and middle name with Bakul Hiralal Shah. Confidence medium.
